final: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase
